preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call callget() function
Victim address must have some BOND token balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the callget() function to transfer tokens from any victim address to your own address. This function bypasses normal ERC20 transfer restrictions and allows the owner to transfer tokens from any address without approval. The vulnerability is that the contract uses 18 decimals internally but the callget() function doesn't properly handle decimal precision, potentially allowing improper transfers.
